title: Track a claim
_note: The public Claim Center lookup form and its claim-number field were inspected on 2026-10-05. The chatbot prefills the claim number only. The customer enters their ID/Iqama/CR on the official page and clicks Track Status; the form result has not been inspected or retrieved by chat.

fields.label: Claim Number
fields.prompt: What is your claim number? I’ll fill it into Mutakamela’s official tracking form. Enter your ID/Iqama/CR there yourself.
fields.prompt_ar: ما رقم المطالبة؟ سأعبئه في نموذج التتبع الرسمي لمتكاملة. أدخل رقم الهوية/الإقامة/السجل التجاري هناك بنفسك.
